Use Tier 2: replace the fixed query scoring head with candidate-conditioned attention pooling inside the existing MaskedSASRec network. Focus on model_design and training_evaluation. The relative-bias, convolution, larger-negative-pool, and separated-view trials all underperformed the 0.580 reference, so retain its backbone, corruption scheme, and objective. Test the hypothesis that compressing each prediction into one candidate-independent query limits discrimination among items representing different interests in a user's history; the observed results do not establish this cause.

For each supervised masked position, use its encoded query and each candidate embedding to construct an attention query over the same sequence's encoded nonpadding positions. Normalize attention across those positions, pool their representations, and pass the pooled context plus the masked-position representation through one shared learned projection and normalization before scoring against that candidate's tied item embedding and jointly trained bias. This replaces the original scoring head and produces one neural score per candidate, with every parameter trained jointly in one model per category. Use only corrupted input representations, never reconstruction labels, to construct attention keys and values; chunk supervised positions and candidates to bound memory without changing the loss. Preserve 256 uniform negatives, target-collision masking, final-versus-auxiliary loss weighting, optimizer settings, seeds, supplied splits, and checkpoint-selection rules.

Implement one shared scoring method for training, validation, and exported prediction, and update checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer to reconstruct and strictly load the modified architecture. Check finite gradients, padding exclusion, candidate-order equivariance, chunked-score agreement, and exported-predictor parity. Retrain all four category models from scratch, load exactly one selected checkpoint per category, and compare authoritative macro HR@10 and category results against 0.580 using the pinned evaluator while reporting actual GPU cost. Preserve DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, category routing, single-GPU execution, the 200-epoch environment default, and existing time limits; leave hidden-test inference and output generation to the host.
